title: Have Note, Will Travel
summary: Draw out the Goblin Task Master, then survive his guards.
overview: Draw out the Goblin Task Master, then survive his guards.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: The first thirty qualifying kills advance the alarm sequence.
Find and defeat the Goblin Task Master when the alarm sounds.
His death summons more guards, so keep tanks and healers ready through the aftermath.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 6.
